global min_x = -800.0
global max_x =  800.0
global min_y = -800.0
global max_y =  800.0
global min_z =   0.0
global max_z = 1300.0

# ---------- Safety Helper Functions ----------
def safety_check(p):
    # p is a pose list [x,y,z,rx,ry,rz] in meters & radians
    # Convert meters to mm for comparison
    x = p[0]*1000
    y = p[1]*1000
    z = p[2]*1000
    if x < min_x or x > max_x: return false
    if y < min_y or y > max_y: return false
    if z < min_z or z > max_z: return false
    return true
end

    # Digital input 0 is wired to the e‑stop button

        popup("EMERGENCY STOP ACTIVATED – Program halted", true, "Error")
        halt()
    end
end

        halt()
